_about: Seedance 2.0 API pricing dataset. Verified 2026-07-21. Unit: USD per SECOND of output video, text-to-video, no video input, unless noted. Prices shift weekly — re-check the source before relying. Full write-up: https://useapi.net/docs/articles/seedance-2-api-pricing

official.notes: Fast/Mini tiers cap at 720p. Audio free on 2.0. Activation needs a prepaid pack (min ~$30, 90-day expiry, non-refundable); no free 2.0 trial. Individual limit 3 concurrent; 4K 1 concurrent. Real-face reference inputs restricted to an enterprise contract from $14,000/yr.

useapi_routes._about: One useapi.net token ($15/mo flat, on top of the underlying consumer account plan) drives all four. usd_per_second below is the generation cost on the cheapest sensible plan for that route.

pixverse.notes: Cheapest verified 1080p, and the lowest-priced 2160p/4K. Ultra plan's 40% third-party discount is outweighed by its worse $/credit, so Premium wins for single clips.

dreamina.notes: Widest model range — the only route with the Seedance 1.x family. 1080p and 4K are Canada-region accounts only.

minimax.notes: 4K plus a deep reference-image workflow. Seedance is billed at half credits (already reflected).

runway.plan: Runway Unlimited (legacy Explore mode) / metered otherwise
runway.notes: Real faces with lighter moderation. Explore-mode unlimited (free at <=720p) is a legacy perk — Runway no longer enables it on new accounts, and it is slow (one clip at a time, 10-15 min). 1080p is metered; the per-second credit rate is not published in the useapi docs, so it is left null here.

third_party_1080p_5s.verdict: VERIFIED — the only reseller below official (thin margin)
VERIFIED +20% — official model badge, transparent per-second pricing
VERIFIED — the market default, and the most expensive standard 2.0 (~82% over ByteDance)

watch_for: Flat per-second rates that are cheap at 1080p but MORE expensive than official at 480p (cross-subsidy).
'Turbo' / 'accelerated' variants that are a distilled model, not standard Seedance 2.0.
Prices quoted at 720p when you wanted 1080p (some 'cheapest Seedance' pages have no 1080p tier at all).
'Unlimited' plans capped below 1080p with slow queues and expiring windows.
Credits with no published dollar value — uncomparable by design.
